# Factur-X Engine — discontinued

Factur-X Engine was discontinued on 24 August 2026. Version 2.1.0 is the final
frozen release. There will be no support, security fixes, regulatory monitoring,
or standards updates. Do not treat it as a maintained production dependency.

The source remains available as-is under the MIT licence. Fork it and assume
maintenance internally, or choose a maintained alternative.

## Technical boundaries

- `/v1/validate` reports executed and skipped validation layers.
- `/v1/extract` is a heuristic preview and is not suitable for automatic import.
- `/v1/serialize` is strict but does not replace client accounting controls.
- Results are not tax, accounting, legal, regulatory, or security advice.

Repository: https://github.com/facturx-engine/facturx-engine
